text:
Leah CSM: Morning team — EBR for BlueHarbor is next Wed (3/31). Need a single slide for onboarding health + top exec asks. Can folks share one-line statuses and owners by EOD today? :wave:
Miguel (Solutions): Slide link here — https://drive.redwood/blueharbor-ebr (I've added a starter slide under 'Onboarding & Risks').
Tori (RevOps): Renewal window shows 3 months out, renewal probability currently 68% (based on usage + CSAT). Biggest risk = tiered billing confusion and delayed enablement.
Alex (CSE): Onboarding status: pilot completed, 2 of 4 integrations live (payments, webhooks). Still waiting on SSO cert from their infra team — blocker for full rollout. Owner: Alex. ETA: 4/7.
Sam (Eng): We shipped the SDK patch yesterday — reduces latency for batch embeddings. PA said they'd rerun test flows this week. I can include perf numbers on the slide if useful. Owner: Sam.
Leah CSM: Good. Can we capture exec asks (1-2 bullets) — ideally things the VP/CTO can approve quickly in-meeting. Example: approve SSO cert priority sprint, approve expansion seat bundle.
Miguel (Solutions): Exec asks candidate 1: expedite SSO certificate support (2-week SLA). Owner: Alex. Exec asks candidate 2: commit to pilot to paid conversion metric: 25% of pilot seats convert -> they want a pricing credits proposal. Owner: Miguel.
Tori (RevOps): I'll prepare a one-slide ask on pricing credits with proposed tiers and ARR impact. Need numbers from Sam + Leah by 2pm.
Leah CSM: Action items so far:
- Alex: SSO follow-up + updated ETA (due 4/7)
- Sam: Perf numbers for embeddings for slide (due today 2pm)
- Miguel: Draft pricing credits ask (due EOD)
- Tori: Finalize ask slide (due tomorrow)
- Leah: Exec one-liner summary + renewal stance (due EOD)
Alex (CSE): Quick note — infra asked for our cert chain in `pem` format. I have it but need Andrew from BlueHarbor to confirm acceptance. I'll ping Andrew after this thread.
Miguel (Solutions): Risk flag: customer reported unexpected token usage spike last week — likely from retained QA traffic. Suggested mitigation: short-term token cap + guidance. Owner: Miguel.
Leah CSM: Can we include a short onboarding health score on slide (0-100)? Proposal: 72 (pilot success, 2 integrations, SSO blocker, billing confusion). Thoughts?
Sam (Eng): 72 seems fair. Add a small note: 'Performance improvement shipped; retest pending.'
Tori (RevOps): Also add 'billing touchpoint completed but need legal signoff on the transfer agreement' — that impacts renewal timeline.
Alex (CSE): I can add a screenshot of integration health (green/yellow) to make it visual.
Miguel (Solutions): I'll capture feedback themes from the CSM interviews: 1) clarity on billing tiers 2) timeline for SSO 3) request for dedicated onboarding SLA. Short bullets.
Leah CSM: OK — final ask: everyone paste your one-line status + final slides section by 6pm. I'll consolidate into the EBR deck and send to execs tomorrow morning.
reminder-bot: Reminder set — "BlueHarbor EBR contributions due" at 18:00 today to @Leah CSM, @Miguel (Solutions), @Tori (RevOps), @Alex (CSE), @Sam (Eng).
Miguel (Solutions): FYI adding a small table for 'Action->Owner->ETA->Risk' on slide 3.
Alex (CSE): Pinged Andrew (BlueHarbor) re: cert pvk. He replied: "We'll validate by EOD Friday". Updating ETA to 4/10 if validation slips.
Leah CSM: Noted. Please mark any ETA slippage in the deck with red icon so execs see impact.
Sam (Eng): Sending perf numbers now: 60% reduction in median latency for embed batches, 12% cost reduction in staging. Pls include.
Tori (RevOps): Uploaded pricing sketch to the deck. Miguel, can you sanity-check the ARR math?
Miguel (Solutions): Will do — doing quick calc now.
Leah CSM: Thanks everyone. I'll post the consolidated deck + talking points at 9am tomorrow. If anything regresses, drop a note here and I'll surface during runthrough. :spiral_calendar:
